images.description: Hairline (brushed) stainless steel, 16 x 16 mm at 50 um/px, lit by a 72-LED ring light at 30 deg elevation (dark field). A curved scratch (V-groove 4-8 um deep, torn rough floor in places) crosses the hairline. The bright streaks along x are glints of the hairline itself, not defects.
images.description_ja: ヘアライン仕上げのステンレス(16 × 16 mm、50 µm/px)を仰角 30° のリング照明(LED 72 個、暗視野)で撮った画像。弧を描く傷(深さ 4〜8 µm の V 溝、底が所々荒れている)がヘアラインを横切る。横方向の明るい筋はヘアライン自身の反射で、欠陥ではない。

images.name: resin_dent_fibre
images.source: computed by Fullseye (tools/gen_fa_samples.py; illumdesign bar light + GGX height-field render)
images.licence: own work (Apache-2.0; computed by Fullseye, no photograph)
images.description: Light-grey injection-moulded resin, 15.4 x 11.5 mm at 40 um/px, lit by a 48-LED bar light raking from the top edge at 25 deg elevation. Two defects: a dent (Gaussian, 80 um deep, sigma 0.56 mm) left of centre, and a dark foreign fibre (1-3 px wide, about 5 mm long) on the right. The slow shading top-to-bottom is the bar light's fall-off, not a defect.
images.description_ja: 薄灰色の射出成形樹脂(15.4 × 11.5 mm、40 µm/px)を、上辺から仰角 25° で斜めに当てたバー照明(LED 48 個)で撮った画像。欠陥は 2 つ: 中央左の打痕(ガウス形、深さ 80 µm、σ 0.56 mm)と、右側の黒い異物の繊維(幅 1〜3 px・長さ約 5 mm)。上から下へのゆるい明暗はバー照明の減衰で、欠陥ではない。

truth.mask_rule: dent: within 2 sigma of its centre; fibre: its painted footprint

images.name: machined_plate_holes
images.source: computed by Fullseye (tools/gen_fa_samples.py; examples/poc_dimensional_inspection.py render_part: SDF part, area coverage, PSF)
images.licence: own work (Apache-2.0; computed by Fullseye, no photograph)
images.description: A machined plate seen in silhouette on a back light (dark = metal, bright = light passing; 12.5 um/px). Eight through-features: a 68.50 px round hole, a 50.50 px wide slot and six 10.5 px bolt holes on a 104 px pitch circle; also a chamfer, a fillet, a step and a 12 deg end face for edge measurement. PSF sigma 1.2 px, noise 0.012, a 10 % left-right illumination slope.
images.description_ja: バックライトで撮った機械加工プレートの影絵(暗 = 金属、明 = 光が抜ける所。12.5 µm/px)。貫通形状は 8 つ: 直径 68.50 px の丸穴、幅 50.50 px の長穴、ピッチ円 104 px 上の直径 10.5 px のボルト穴 6 個。面取り・丸み・段差・12° の端面もあり、エッジ計測にも使える。PSF σ 1.2 px、雑音 0.012、左右 10 % の照明傾斜。

truth.mask_rule: pixel centres inside the analytic hole / slot boundaries

images.name: weld_xray_porosity
images.source: computed by Fullseye (tools/gen_fa_samples.py; examples/poc_weld_radiograph_porosity.py render: Beer-Lambert, scatter, Poisson)
images.licence: own work (Apache-2.0; computed by Fullseye, no photograph)
images.description: X-ray radiograph of a butt weld in 10 mm steel (0.1 mm/px; bright = thinner). The darker horizontal band is the weld cap (2 mm reinforcement). 7 spherical gas pores, 0.6-2.0 mm diameter, sit in the weld; scatter (SPR 0.5), detector blur and photon noise are modelled. Shown with a linear display window (the 0.1-99.9 percentile range mapped to black-white).
images.description_ja: 板厚 10 mm 鋼の突合せ溶接の X 線透過像(0.1 mm/px、明るい = 薄い)。横に走る暗い帯は余盛(高さ 2 mm)。溶接部に直径 0.6〜2.0 mm の球形の気孔が 7 個ある。散乱(散乱/一次線比 0.5)・検出器のぼけ・光子雑音を模している。表示用に線形のウィンドウ処理(0.1〜99.9 パーセンタイルを黒〜白に)をかけてある。

truth.mask_rule: pixel centres inside each pore's projected circle
